summary: mixture of elastic solids sharing the same reference configuration and deformation gradient; stress = sum of solids' stresses. `mat_axis` may be at `<material>` level and/or per `<solid>` and compounds (see Uncoupled Solid Mixture notes).
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.1.4.27 Solid Mixture, p233（4.13）

solid.meaning: Container tag for unconstrained solid material (any number)
solid.note: 手册列出该参数，但 pyfebio 当前版本没有对应字段，建模时无法传入。

example.source: pyfebio 0.3.0 默认值，已通过构造验证；数值为占位默认，建模前请按实际工况替换。
